keySentence: Then, the little elves made shoes while he slept.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The elves were tiny. They sewed very fast. The shoes were perfect. Then, the little elves made shoes while he slept.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker and his wife watched the elves with amazement. The tiny elves had no shoes or warm clothes of their own. Then, the little elves made shoes while he slept peacefully. Their tiny fingers moved quickly and skillfully all night. The shoemaker felt grateful and wanted to thank them. He decided to make something special for the elves.
